author: Aspire Starter Platform
name: Aspire Vertical Slice Service
description: Adds a service to an existing Aspire Vertical Slice Platform solution: Wolverine HTTP endpoints, vertical slices, EF Core on PostgreSQL, Keycloak authentication and a sample CRUD feature. Create it from the solution's src/Services folder.

CorsOrigin.description: First trusted CORS origin. The service refuses to start with an empty allow list.

postActions.description: Wire the new service into the solution

manualInstructions.text:
The service ships with its own migrations and generated endpoints, so it runs as soon as it is wired in.

1. Add the project: dotnet sln add src/Services/<ServiceName>/<ServiceName>.csproj
2. Reference it from the AppHost: dotnet add src/App/App.AppHost reference src/Services/<ServiceName>
3. Register it in src/App/App.AppHost/AppHost.cs:
     var <lower>Db = postgres.AddDatabase("<lower>db", "<lower>");

     var <lower> = builder.AddProject<Projects.<ServiceName>>("<lower>")
         .WithReference(<lower>Db).WaitFor(<lower>Db)
         .WithReference(cache).WaitFor(cache)
         .WithExternalHttpEndpoints();
4. With the Keycloak provider, add '<lower>.WithReference(keycloak).WaitFor(keycloak);' inside the existing if block, and add a client plus audience mapper for '<lower>-api' in src/App/App.AppHost/Keycloak/starter-realm.json.

Afterwards, regenerate only when the model or an endpoint signature changes:
  dotnet ef migrations add <Name> --project src/Services/<ServiceName> --output-dir Data/Migrations
  dotnet run --project src/Services/<ServiceName> --no-launch-profile -- codegen write
